rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or group that succeeds, becomes prosperous, or does well.

example.english: You really prosper in your new job! You
example.traditional: 你轉咗份工之後，真係發達喎！
example.jyutping: nei5 zyun2 zo2 fan6 gung1 zi1 hau6 zan1 hai6 faat3 daat6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when prospering specifically means becoming wealthy or making substantial financial gains.

example.english: They prosper by making big money through property investment.
example.traditional: 佢靠炒樓賺大錢，真係發財。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 caau2 lau2 zaan6 daai6 cin4 zan1 hai6 faat3 coi4

rows.note: Use this mainly for a business, organization, household, or other undertaking that is thriving.

example.english: This cha chaan teng’s business continues to prosper as customers flock in.
example.traditional: 呢排客似雲來，呢間茶餐廳生意好興旺。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 haak3 ci5 wan4 loi4 ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 saang1 ji3 hou2 hing1 wong6
